name: quiroads
description: Four skills for people who market health clinics: audit who owns and controls a clinic's Meta Ads assets, review ads and landing pages against platform policies and health advertising rules, set up lead follow-up over WhatsApp, SMS and calls, and turn first visits into care plans.
